heroTitle:
Turn a health shock
into a predictable payment.
intro: Build the insurance benchmark from first principles: uncertainty, risk aversion, expected utility, risk pooling, fair premiums, optimal indemnity and the insurer's zero-profit condition.
attribution: Independent student-written study guide based on Daniele Fabbri’s Fundamentals in Health Economics, Session 6: Why and how do we insure against health shocks? Official slides, charts and textbook materials are not reproduced. Always check Virtuale for the official materials.
